svg.title: SSCCS: Scheme–Segment Composition Computing System
svg.desc: The model as one landscape: immutable segments on a coordinate space, a scheme binding them into a layout, a field raising a constraint potential, observers whose lines of sight are transmitted through the structure, and the state they record.

text.font-family: Archivo SemiBold, Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Computation as the observation of deterministic structure
